Kernel-based mutual information: low-rank core

Source: R/search_causal_order.r
kernel_mi_core_lowrank.Rd

Low-rank counterpart of kernel_mi_core(). With K2 ~= G2 %*% t(G2), both S = tmp2^2 - t(W) %*% W and tmp2^2 reduce to c0^2*I + G2 %*% C %*% t(G2) for a d2 x d2 matrix C, via the Woodbury identity on W and the matrix determinant lemma on the resulting rank-d2 update. The n*log(c0) terms in logdet(S) and logdet(tmp2^2) cancel in their difference, so only d2 x d2 matrices remain.

Usage

kernel_mi_core_lowrank(prep1, x2, kappa, sigma)

Arguments

prep1

Output of kernel_mi_prepare_lowrank() for variable 1

x2

Vector of variable 2

kappa

Regularization parameter

sigma

Width of the Gaussian kernel

Value

Mutual information
